mass_definition: sum over bundle sources of frozen dataset probability multiplied by unique source-group audio hours
early_stop_policy: after 6 full DEV checks without at least 0.001 absolute WER improvement
rationale: One deterministic sampled-audio exposure rule scales every experiment, protects tiny CMU and VOiCES bundles with a bounded minimum and protects the larger AGE/AMI mixtures from unbounded schedules with a fixed maximum. DEV early stopping remains the final bound.
